description: This file defines an Android Activity named CardFlipActivity that demonstrates a card flip animation using fragment transactions, custom animations, back stack management, and UI controls like action bar menu items. It also contains inner classes for front and back fragment representations of the card.

classes.name: CardFlipActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling the card flip animation, menu options, and back stack management. Contains inner classes for front and back fragments.

classes.name: CardFrontFragment
classes.description: Fragment representing the front side of the card.

classes.name: CardBackFragment
classes.description: Fragment representing the back side of the card.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, adds the front fragment if needed, and registers back stack change listener.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates action bar menu with flip or photo/info button based on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, including navigating up and flipping the card.

methods.name: flipCard
methods.description: Performs the card flip animation by replacing fragments with custom animations and updating the back stack.

methods.name: onBackStackChanged
methods.description: Updates UI state flags when back stack changes, invalidates options menu.
